source_label: Recalculated from the current database; not archived email snapshots
method: Exact document counts by recorded collection timestamp for each Asia/Shanghai calendar day, using the original daily-report rule. No additional distinct-vacancy deduplication is applied by the report.
coverage: Five existing series; 69 complete days per series. The page displays four of those series.
verification: All five series match the existing 2026-08-02 and 2026-08-03 observations. The 2026-08-03 values also match the last received daily-report email.
zeros: A zero is a successful exact count of records currently stored for that day, not a substituted missing value.
current_day: 2026-10-12 was unfinished at extraction and is excluded from this backfill.
limitations: Counts are a reconstruction from records present at query time, not proof of complete market capture or unique vacancies.
The unfinished current day is excluded.
Changes, deletions, or corrections after the original report date can change historical counts; reconstructed values are not archived email snapshots.
